data.name: Caesar
data.description: Substitution cipher that shifts the alphabet by a fixed amount, based on modular arithmetic (C = (P + shift) mod 26).

shift.title: Shift
shift.description: Number of positions each letter is shifted. Any integer is accepted; only its value mod 26 matters.

data.name: Vigenère
data.description: Polyalphabetic cipher: modular sum of the text and a repeating key (C = (P + K) mod 26).

key.title: Key
key.description: Keyword made only of letters (A-Z, case-insensitive), repeated along the text.

data.name: Hill
data.description: Polygraphic cipher based on linear algebra: each block of letters is transformed by a key matrix in modular arithmetic (C = K x P mod 26). Operates only on letters (A-Z), normalized to uppercase.

key.title: Key matrix
key.description: Square matrix of integers, from 2x2 to 6x6, whose determinant is coprime with 26 (e.g. [[3, 3], [2, 5]]).

data.name: AES-256-GCM
data.description: Modern authenticated encryption using the OpenSSL primitive (not reimplemented by hand). Combines confidentiality (AES-256) and integrity (GCM tag) in a single operation.

key.title: Key
key.description: Any non-empty string. It is turned into a 256-bit key with SHA-256, a deliberate simplification: real systems should use a proper KDF.

data.name: SHA-256
data.description: One-way cryptographic hash function (256 bits), using the native and trusted PHP implementation.

data.name: SHA-512
data.description: One-way cryptographic hash function (512 bits), using the native and trusted PHP implementation.

data.name: Base64
data.description: Reversible transformation from binary data to ASCII text. It is not a security mechanism.

data.name: Hexadecimal
data.description: Reversible transformation from binary data to base-16 text. It is not a security mechanism.
